newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Anhui Expressway IPO priced at HK$1.77/shr - sources.
newsitem.headline: Anhui Expressway IPO priced at HK$1.77/shr - sources.

text.p: Anhui Expressway Co Ltd's initial public offering in Hong Kong is expected to be priced at HK$1.77 per share, market sources said on Tuesday.

The Hong Kong offering will run from October 31 to November 5 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on November 13, the market sources said. They said the international portion of the IPO was about three times subscribed subject to adjustment.
The China toll roads operator is due to hold a media briefing in Hong Kong on Wednesday.

Anhui Expressway is expected to offer 493 million H-shares, of which 85 percent was offered to international investors and 15 percent will be offered to local investors. The initial price range was HK$1.59 to HK$1.92 per share, market sources said.
Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd and CEF Capital Ltd are the sponsors and lead underwriters of the issue.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.
Anhui Expressway owns, operates and develops toll roads in China's central Anhui Province. The company currently owns and operates the 134-kilometre Hening (Hefei-Nanjing) Expressway.
